Before retrying enter, validate generated supervisor JSON. If a file is all NUL, preserve it with a unique .corrupt suffix, verify farmer health, then regenerate only that derived state. Never delete or overwrite session, research, model, or user data as a blanket recovery.
Check claim ownership, lease, and checkout cleanliness before reaping a stale session; preserve blocked, submitted, and dirty worktrees.
On Windows, verify repository-local core.longpaths before creating deep project worktrees; do not change global Git configuration.
